templates: original TEST 3D RAW-route factor templates (feasgen.py templates)
schedule: feasgen.schedule: block pattern K0,K1,K0,K2,K1,K3; templates ordered by sha256('R10F|family|cycle')

label_contract.POSITIVE: teacher original-y query y=1 (BD3DS66_TEACHER_V2, first feasible grasp, RRT max_iters 5000)
label_contract.NEGATIVE_CERTIFIED: y=0 with negative_kind CERTIFIED (every grasp fails a deterministic geometric check)
label_contract.UNKNOWN: y=0 with NO_PLAN_FOUND/TIMEOUT/OTHER (budget-relative; reported separately, never a certified negative)

acceptance: all labelled scenes of all dispatched jobs; exact-geometry collisions with registered scenes excluded and ledgered; no model output is consulted
